name: 27106-imageprefill-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One vLLM engine, served in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 2, warmup 25%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2048 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. Seed static 27106, which also fixes the image stream.
workload: single-turn image prefill, synthesised by guidellm from two --data sources: a 32-token instruction (min == max) declaring output_tokens 8, and one 1280x720 jpeg per request (quality 85, gradient content). The image resolves to grid [1, 52, 92] = 4784 ViT patches -> 1196 merged vision tokens, so ~97% of the prompt is image. Every row's image is distinct.
purpose: A vision assistant captioning single 720p photos with short answers for two concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 8192

# Prefix caching is ON by default at this engine, so this line is doing work: do not drop it as a
# no-op. Every synthesised image and prompt is distinct, so a cache can only add warm-up drift.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# `disable-log-requests` is a read-only deprecated property at this engine, not a constructor
# field: passing it raises TypeError before the engine is built. `enable-log-requests: false` is
# the accepted spelling of the same thing.
enable-log-requests: false
